shouldHaveHappened: Yesterday's exchange was a mess, so today's step stays on the two-ball exchange (the same or a smaller piece of it, not three balls yet), fully defined (living room, 6 pm, about 10 minutes). Across the kickoff and the reply to their question, ZOH gives what they need: the standard, well-known fix (throw the second ball when the first peaks, toss it on the inside so the paths cross in an X, catch and pause), and may suggest a YouTube search phrase for the two-ball exchange. Plain and grounded: no invented sources or video titles, no lecture, at most about 8 short lines in a text that teaches. The kickoff asks one thing, never what time. The check-in before 6 is short.
